picoquic/util.c:picoquic_parse_hexa_digi.rationale: Both bodies map 0-9, A-F, and a-f to 0-15 and return -1 otherwise.

picoquic/util.c:picoquic_sprintf.rationale: C performs vsnprintf formatting and returns 0/truncation/error status while Rust copies an already-built string and returns Ok length or BufferTooSmall.
